_doc: Reward penalty weights and curriculum thresholds. training/reward_config.py loads this file for the trainer (envs/locomotion.py, envs/slap.py, levels.py); the Unreal DataAsset USlapRewardConfig (Source/PoSlapUnreal/SlapRewardConfig.h) mirrors the same values for the editor and the diagnostics overlay. Weights are added to the per-step reward (negative = penalty). torque_sq = sum of squared joint torques (qfrc_actuator, N m); joint_ang_vel_sq = sum of squared joint angular velocities (rad/s); action_rate_sq = |a_t - a_(t-1)|^2; foot_slip = planar foot speed above foot_slip_deadband_mps while the sole is on the floor (m/s). The shipped brains predate torque_sq and joint_ang_vel_sq (added 2026-11-20, not retrained): see docs/reward_config.md.
